summary: Tested 2 NEW features for Skaegagamer app: (1) Active/Brumation toggle per dragon on Overview screen, (2) Dragons screen card layout change (edit icon moved next to name). Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases passed covering activity-state PUT endpoint (valid states, 422 for invalid enum, 400 for invalid id, 404 for nonexistent dragon), daily-overview activity_state field, feeding-task filtering in brumation, filtering reversal on switch back to active, and per-dragon isolation (2 dragons, only one toggled). Frontend: verified interactively via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844) - Active icon shows colored/Brumation grey when active=default; tapping Brumation icon shows success toast ('Sif is active again - feeding shows as normal' toast confirmed on reverse action too), icons swap colors correctly, and all 3 feeding rows (8AM, 9AM, 4PM) disappear from Sif's column leaving only 4 tasks (UVB 7AM/8:30PM automatic + 2 care tasks); switching back to Active restored all 7 tasks and swapped icons back. Persistence verified: navigated Overview->Dragons->Overview, brumation state and filtered task list remained correctly persisted (backed by DB PUT, confirmed via re-fetch). Dragons tab card layout: edit (pencil) icon confirmed rendered inline next to dragon name at top of card (not in the right icon column anymore), tapping it correctly navigates to /dragon-form?id=... ; weight and delete icons confirmed present and functional in the now-2-icon right column; card layout is clean with no overlapping text, adequate spacing for meta info (gender/color/morph) and age badge.
action_items: No blocking issues found. Minor note: Tabs.Screen 'tabBarTestID' (e.g. 'tab-dragons', 'tab-overview') does NOT render as a queryable data-testid on the web preview DOM (confirmed via Playwright - selector timed out); had to fall back to text-based tab selectors ('text=Dragons'). This is a PRE-EXISTING navigation testID issue (not part of this review's 2 new features) but worth flagging to main agent for future E2E test reliability if bottom-tab testIDs are expected to work on web.
Both new features are working correctly end-to-end and ready for production.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/dragons.py activity-state endpoint: correctly validates via Pydantic Literal type (ActivityState = Literal['active','brumation']) causing automatic 422 on invalid values - no manual validation needed, clean implementation.

backend/routes/overview.py: feeding filter done via simple Mongo query modifier ($ne: 'fodring') scoped per-dragon inside the existing per-dragon loop - correctly isolated, no cross-dragon leakage, verified via test_brumation_per_dragon_isolation.

frontend/components/DragonColumn.tsx: handleSetActivity has proper guard against redundant calls (state === dragon.activity_state) and disables buttons during in-flight request (updatingActivity) preventing double-taps/race conditions - good defensive UX.

frontend/app/(tabs)/dragons.tsx: activityToggle icons use fixed 30x30 Image touch targets without explicit padding - touch target itself is only 30x30pt which is below the 44x44pt minimum recommended touch target guideline (though this matches pattern in existing edit/weight/delete icon buttons in dragons.tsx which use 40x40/32x32 wrapper views); low-priority since testing found no missed-taps in practice.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passing (icon color states, toast, live task filtering, persistence across nav, per-dragon isolation, dragons card layout/edit-weight-delete icons)

seed_data_creation: No new dragons created for this session's frontend tests - reused existing dragon 'Sif' (id 6a4635bd66e797e6db9b8f13) and toggled its activity_state active->brumation->active multiple times, always left in default 'active' state at end of session (verified via final screenshot showing 7/7 feeding+care+light tasks restored). Backend pytest created/deleted its own TEST_ActivityDragon and TEST_ActivityDragon2 dragons with proper teardown fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both NEW features (activity_state brumation toggle + dragons card layout) are fully implemented, tested, and working correctly - backend validation (422 on bad enum), per-dragon task filtering, live UI refetch after toggle, state persistence across navigation, and the repositioned edit icon on dragons.tsx all verified via direct interaction (not just visual screenshot) with Playwright on mobile viewport. Previously tested features (localization, weight/time settings, care-plan reset+AI translation) were not touched and Sif dragon was left in default active/full-task state. Only a minor pre-existing note about tabBarTestID not rendering as data-testid on web was flagged for the main agent's awareness (not a new-feature bug).
